This contains projects to generate opencv.js typescript typings project from scratch. It only generate typescript definitions (.d.ts files), zero code.

Projects:

 * [opencv-compiler](opencv-compiler/README.md): clones specific version of opencv from github and build opencv.js and XML documentation (necessary for the generator). Requisites: docker
 * [opencv-ts](opencv-ts/README.md): npm project with opencv.js typings. The thing we want to publish in npm so users can npm-install it in their typescript projects. 100% generated by opencv-types-generator
 * [opencv-types-generator](opencv-types-generator/README.md): Given a opencv build folders (what opencv-compiler generates), it generates the project opencv-ts
 * [test-projects](test-projects/README.md): some typescript projects testing the typings both in web and node.js using npm and modern bundlers.
